content:
Division in Class 2 is fair sharing and grouping, and it undoes multiplication. This guide explains what the IMO Class 2 division chapter tests, the facts to know, the traps, and a free 10-question online test with answers.

What the Class 2 Maths Olympiad Division chapter tests

  • Equal sharing (how many each?) and grouping (how many groups?)
  • Division facts and fact families
  • The link between multiplication and division
  • Simple word problems

Key facts your child should know

  • 12 ÷ 4 = 3: 12 shared among 4 gives 3 each.
  • Division and multiplication are a fact family: 4 × 3 = 12 → 12 ÷ 4 = 3.
  • Sharing asks how many each; grouping asks how many groups.
  • A number divided by 1 stays the same; divided by itself gives 1.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Mixing up sharing and grouping in a word problem.
  • Forgetting that division is the opposite of multiplication.
  • Getting the fact family the wrong way round.

quiz.title: IMO Class 2 Division Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.explanation: Multiplication and division are opposites: because 8 × 7 = 56, we get 56 ÷ 7 = 8.

questions.q: Sara divides 40 chocolates equally between 8 cousins. How many chocolates go to each?
questions.explanation: Sharing equally means dividing: 40 ÷ 8 = 5 chocolates for each.

questions.q: Ayaan divides 40 by 5 and then adds 5 to the answer. What number does Ayaan get?
A shopkeeper packs 54 pencils into boxes of 6 each. How many boxes are filled?
questions.explanation: 54 pencils put 6 at a time make 54 ÷ 6 = 9 full boxes.
Think of the table: 8 × 5 = 40, so 40 ÷ 8 = 5. The missing number is 8.

questions.q: A librarian packs 49 books into piles of 7 each. How many piles are filled?
questions.explanation: 49 books put 7 at a time make 49 ÷ 7 = 7 full piles.

questions.q: Arjun shares 45 sweets equally among 5 friends. How many sweets does each one get?
questions.explanation: 45 ÷ 5 = 9, so each of the 5 friends gets 9 sweets.

questions.q: Which gives the greater answer: 24 ÷ 4 or 30 ÷ 5?
questions.explanation: 24 ÷ 4 = 6 and 30 ÷ 5 = 6. Both answers are the same.

questions.q: Dev divides 36 by 6 and then adds 3 to the answer. What number does Dev get?

faq.q: How is division related to multiplication?
faq.a: They are opposites. Because 4 × 3 = 12, we know 12 ÷ 4 = 3 and 12 ÷ 3 = 4 — the same fact family.

faq.q: What is the difference between sharing and grouping?
faq.a: Sharing splits a total into a set number of equal groups; grouping makes groups of a fixed size and counts them.
